title: Resume From Continuity Context
description: Measure whether an agent can identify the current project state, active phase, and next action from Zenith continuity context.
prompt: You are resuming work in a Zenith-enabled repository. Determine the current next step, identify blockers or cleanup needs, and state the first implementation action you would take.
setup: Create or select an active roadmap-backed plan with one in-progress phase.
Leave at least one recent session or decision in memory.
successCriteria: Mentions the active plan and current phase.
Identifies dirty worktree or blocking findings when present.
Does not invent roadmap items that are not in Zenith memory.
privacyRules: Do not store full model transcripts.
Do not include secrets, credentials, tokens, or full diffs in benchmark records.
Record only scenario id, variant, timestamps, and evaluator-entered scores.

metrics.label: Identified next step
metrics.description: Whether the response names the correct next action.

metrics.label: Continuity score
metrics.description: Evaluator score from 1 to 5 for resumption quality.
